key_insight: Aeneas translates ownership-safe Rust into Lean, enabling scalable machine-checked proofs of cryptographic software without low-level aliasing and liveness reasoning.
engineering_relevance: The approach shows that production-oriented verified Rust can deliver safety, panic-freedom, correctness, portability, and performance for real cryptographic libraries across x86-64 and ARM.
method: Extract pure Rust models into Lean via Aeneas
Use Lean tactics and libraries to prove functional correctness over extracted code
Apply AI agents to draft proofs and assist with standards/intrinsics formalization
evidence_signal: The authors report a 237KLOC Lean development verifying 16.7KLOC of Rust, covering safety, panic-freedom, and functional correctness for post-quantum cipher suites on x86-64 and ARM.
watch_item: Formalizing cryptographic standards and platform-specific intrinsics still needs expert design and review, so automation does not eliminate specification risk.
paper_title: Scaling Verification of Cryptographic Software with Aeneas, Rust, and Lean
